author: ETA PRIME
description:
The Retroid Pocket 6 brings a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 and a 120Hz AMOLED display to Retroid’s “pocket-sized” lineup. Here’s how it feels, what’s new in the software, and how far it can push Android gaming and emulation.

Buy It Here: https://www.goretroid.com/collections/frontpage/products/retroid-pocket-6-handheld?sca_ref=2985949.aFrgTZqsDf

In this first look at the Retroid Pocket 6, I break down the hardware upgrades, redesigned ergonomics, and the new system controls Retroid added for tuning performance and thermals.
